quests.instruction: What is the opposite of "Agile"? (a cheetah cutting sharply after its prey vs. a tired shuffle that barely covers any ground)
quests.question: Agile

quests.explanation: "Agile" means able to move quickly and change direction with ease. "Sluggish" means slow-moving and lacking energy. Since those are completely different, Sluggish is the opposite of Agile!
